title: Normalized cohomology comparison for an exact derived functor
statement: Let $\mathcal A,\mathcal B$ be abelian categories [def-sp-abelian] with chosen ordinary unbounded derived-category localizations $Q_{\mathcal A}$ and $Q_{\mathcal B}$ [def-weil-abstract-derived-category]. Let $F:\mathcal A\to\mathcal B$ be additive and preserve finite limits and finite colimits, and write $D(F)$ for its functor on derived categories induced by termwise application to cochain complexes. For each $n\in\mathbf Z$, define $\theta^n_F:F\circ H^n_{\mathcal A}\simeq H^n_{\mathcal B}\circ D(F)$, with component $(\theta^n_F)_K:F(H^nK)\simeq H^n(D(F)K)$. This is the canonical natural isomorphism obtained by lifting through the localization the inverse of the exact-functor comparison $H^n(C(F)P)\simeq F(H^nP)$ on cochain complexes $P$, transported by $H^n_{\mathcal A}\circ Q_{\mathcal A}\simeq H^n$, $D(F)\circ Q_{\mathcal A}\simeq Q_{\mathcal B}\circ C(F)$, and the corresponding $\mathcal B$ cohomology factorization. Here $C(F)$ applies $F$ termwise, and the complex comparison is induced by preservation of kernels, images and their quotient. This defines a specific comparison on all unbounded derived objects, rather than choosing an arbitrary natural isomorphism.

noncomputable def mapDerivedCategoryHomologyFunctorIso (F : C ⥤ D) [F.Additive]
    [PreservesFiniteLimits F] [PreservesFiniteColimits F] (n : ℤ) :
    DerivedCategory.homologyFunctor C n ⋙ F ≅
      F.mapDerivedCategory ⋙ DerivedCategory.homologyFunctor D n
